title: Omega Mag-Bind Blood & Tissue DNA 96 Kit Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load lysed samples onto magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place lysed samples (up to 250 µL per well) into a NEST or USA Scientific 96‑deepwell plate positioned on the magnetic module (slot 1). Use the layout shown for the two 12‑channel reservoirs. Map each extraction plate well directly to the elution PCR plate (slot 5): A1→A1, B1→B1, … D2→D2.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons software set the following options: *Park tips*: yes (recommended) to conserve tips between reagent addition and removal; tips will be parked in the corresponding well of an empty rack. *Track tips across runs*: yes to continue from the last used column, or no to start at column 1 of tiprack 1. *Flash*: yes to flash rail lights during pauses, or no to keep lights steady.

substeps.instruction: Set Track tips across runs = yes or no as desired.
Set Flash = yes or no as desired.

steps.title: Select and download protocol
steps.instruction: Choose the appropriate protocol (Omega Mag‑Bind Blood & Tissue DNA 96 Kit, 250 µL blood version) in the Opentrons app and download the protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange deck as per the provided deck map: place magnetic module in slot 1, elution PCR plate in slot 5, tip racks, and the two 12‑channel reservoirs in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, perform calibration of all labware, tip racks, and the pipette according to the app’s calibration routine (refer to support article for tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated DNA extraction.
